title: Close an attached-lid tote: bring both lids down over the stepped seam together
instruction: Close the lids of the tote.
context: Attached-lid totes are a standard container for order picking and distribution. Stockers and order fillers (O*NET 53-7065.00; 2,804,300 US employees in 2025, BLS data as shown on O*NET) fill customers' orders from warehouse stock; their O*NET core tasks include packing and unpacking items in warehouses and issuing merchandise. Hand packers and packagers (O*NET 53-7064.00; 555,500 employees in 2025) seal containers. Closing a tote's lids is part of that handling, not a separately listed task. The two lids of this tote meet along a stepped seam where each laps over the other.
setup: Positions in cm from the midpoint between the two arm bases, on the table (x forward, y left); one fixed layout, matching the screenshot. One Akro-Mils 39085 attached-lid container (product page: akro-mils.com/product/attached-lid-container-39085/), blue plastic (catalogue outside size 21.5 x 15 x 9 in = 54.6 x 38.1 x 22.9 cm, taken at the rim band; some resellers list the width as 15.25 in), footprint centred at x 52, y 0, long side along x, standing on its base. Tub (estimated from a product photo description): walls 0.4 cm thick taper inward toward the base, which is 2.5 cm in on each side from the rim outline (about 5.6 degrees lean); a 3.5 cm tall, 1.2 cm thick rim band runs round the top, standing 0.6 cm proud of the wall; under the band are rectangular slots 2 cm tall (two 6 cm wide on each long wall, two 5 cm wide on each end wall); 5 shallow panels with 3 mm ribs on each long wall and 2 on each end wall; a 0.6 cm tall foot ring under a floor 0.8 cm thick; 1.9 kg. Two lids, each a 53.8 cm long, 0.4 cm thick plate about 18.5 cm wide, 0.4 kg (estimated), hinged on the two long sides on axes 0.4 cm outside the rim band, with 7 hinge knuckles (4 cm long, 1.2 cm diameter) per side along each hinge. Seam (estimated): stepped like a Z. In the -x half of the lids' length the seam lies 1.75 cm toward -y of the centre line, in the +x half 1.75 cm toward +y, joined by a 45 degree jog 1.7 cm long. In each half the wider lid has a raised flange (underside 1.6 cm above the plate, reaching 0.8 cm past the seam) on a 0.4 cm riser, over the other lid's low tongue, which stops 0.2 cm short of the riser; the +y lid is the wider one in the -x half. A 2 x 2.5 x 0.8 cm raised seal block with a 0.6 cm square hole through it sits at each lid's seam ends. Each lid has a 5 x 3 x 0.7 cm raised stacking lug at each outer corner on the hinge side, and two round bosses (2.4 cm diameter, 0.3 cm high) on its top. The seam and lap geometry is estimated; see fidelity. At the start both lids lie open and flat, outward, on their hinge stops (180 degrees). Both arms start in the raised ready pose, grippers open.
scoring: Tools: tape measure, straightedge, ruler, phone level. 0 for the whole trial if the tote ever slides more than 3 cm from its mark or tilts 10 degrees or more. A lid is seated when its free (seam-side) edge, at the middle of its straight seam section (the -x half for the +y lid, the +x half for the -y lid), is within 3 mm of the rim plane (ruler under the edge, straightedge across the rim). 1.0 once both lids are seated, still, and both grippers are 3 cm or more from the tote, held 2 s. Otherwise at the end, and only if both grippers are 3 cm or more from the tote (else 0): 0.5 if one lid is seated and the other is propped on its lap (open less than 10 degrees); 0.25 if exactly one lid is seated, or both are down (open less than 10 degrees) without the hold; 0 in every other case.
reset_notes: Open both lids flat outward until they stop, and put the tote back on its mark. Nothing is consumed.
fidelity: Rigid tub, lids, stepped lap and seal blocks; one hinge per lid (stop 180 degrees, viscous damping); no plastic flex. Outside size is catalogue; taper, rim, slots, thicknesses, seam, lap, damping, masses are estimates. The lids lap over each other and cannot be closed one at a time; they close together, as in a seller's product video (0:19; amazon.ca/vdp/09c3c1c46a40487390129b9b26503d1c).
